sn51.28:1.1: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ bhagavā etadavoca
sn51.28:1.2: katamā nu kho ānanda iddhi katamo iddhipādo katamā iddhipādabhāvanā katamā iddhipādabhāvanāgāminī paṭipadāti.
sn51.28:2.1: idhānanda bhikkhu anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhoti ekopi hutvā bahudhā hoti bahudhāpi hutvā eko hoti …pe… yāva brahmalokāpi kāyena vasaṃ vatteti.
sn51.28:3.2: yo ānanda maggo yā paṭipadā iddhilābhāya iddhipaṭilābhāya saṃvattati.
